speaker: richard_burbage
text: Stop me there, Will. I have held these speeches so hard all month that I cannot feel the join from the lists to the farewell to Gaunt. It sounds as if three different men had learned them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A plain reading, Dick, no more, before anybody changes a word. Read them straight through, and let the cues join them.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Take it from the banishment. I will give you Bolingbroke flat on the tail of your verse.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: From the top of the lists again. Plain, without the flourish.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: There. It is one man again on the second time through.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it there. Nobody changes a word of it now.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then the lists at Coventry. Sly and Gus need room for the lances.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Where does the Marshal stand when the trumpets go?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: By the left post, George. Wait. The armour-basket is in Will Sly's way.

speaker: will_sly
text: Master Will. Leave the basket. I had my hand out for it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The stool, Tom. Under him, before he tries to stand.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Here is the stool. Easy down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A duke of threescore, and the back is thirty-one. Let me sit.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Shall we call the morning off?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. Keep the joins while we have them. I can speak Gaunt from this stool for the rest of the morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Stay on the stool, Will. An old man who cannot stand up to the king is the best thing in it.

speaker: will_sly
text: I will put the basket under the stair myself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not cast this afternoon, Will. When Gaunt is off the boards I am going home by way of every wall.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Take your time on the stones, and do not touch another basket.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Keep off the cobbles till you must.

speaker: john_heminges
text: George has the lane, if you want an arm as far as the gate.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Rest it, old Lancaster. The stool stays where it is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the stool by the post. I am done standing.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: We have the second time through. That is the morning I came for.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And I have not said my eighteen lines, which is a mercy to everyone but the tree.
